summary: This experimental document describes a Path Computation Element based procedure for computing constrained point-to-multipoint traffic engineering paths across multiple domains in MPLS and GMPLS networks. Such paths are needed to deliver multicast-style services over several networks.

eli5.summary: Planning a delivery route that splits to many towns across several countries is hard. This RFC tries a method where a helper computer works out the best branching route.
